name: Papepo Smartton
author: PAPEPO

sections.description:
Papepo Smartton switches contact channels based on office hours (including overnight ranges), supports a multi-staff WhatsApp popup, and stores click analytics in your own database.

Analytics stay on your server. Optional URL hashing reduces stored page-path detail. This plugin does not claim legal GDPR certification.
sections.installation:
1. Upload papepo-smartton to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Configure numbers and hours under Papepo Smartton.
